verdict.rationale: Parsec documents keyboard and mouse support, lets guests take control of the host, and passes Wacom pressure and tilt through, so input forwarding is a first-party capability. Nothing documents scroll handling or confirms that input is injected as native host events, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit scroll-wheel/trackpad scroll support, documentation that input arrives as native OS events, independent or hands-on corroboration of input fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events

citations.quote: a team member can observe or even take control of your computer
